source: NSE daily bhavcopy, every session, delisted companies included
universe: NSE stocks trading Rs 10 crore a day or more, priced Rs 20 or more
rules: Bought at the next session's open, held for the period, left on a close under the exit line. Price returns before costs and tax. Index: Nifty 500.

young.what: Companies listed six to twelve months, their 6-month return standing in for the 12-month one, placed against the established universe.
Companies listed six to twelve months, their 6-month return standing in for the 12-month one, placed against the established universe.

results.what: Liquid companies whose quarterly results were first priced in the last 10 sessions, ordered by that session's move less the average liquid stock's. A list is made only when eight or more qualify.
results.bias: The results table holds companies listed today. vs_reporters compares the list with every company it was chosen from, which shares that bias.

short.what: A close above a 40-session range 18% wide or tighter on twice the usual volume in the last five sessions, still above it; above the 200-day average; leader score in the top half; six or more of nine chart conditions; its industry in the top half on money flow; no fall in profit last quarter; results, if just out, not sold by the market.
short.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
short.bias: Industries are NSE's list as it stands today, and quarterly results start in 2018 and cover companies listed today. Before 2018 the profit screen passes everyone.

breakout.what: Forty sessions inside an 18% range, then a close above its top on twice the usual volume within the last five sessions; above the 200-day average; leader score in the top half.
breakout.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.

technical.what: Seven or more of nine chart conditions met: price above the 20-day average, the 20 above the 50, the 50 above the 200, RSI over 55, MACD above its signal, ADX 25 or more with buyers ahead, more volume on up days, this week's volume above usual, and within 5% of the 52-week high.
technical.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.

quick.what: In an uptrend, leader score in the top 30%, two-day RSI under 10. Sold at the first close above the 5-day average, after seven sessions, or on a close 7% under the entry.
quick.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.

flow.what: The four sectors ranked highest on turnover share against their own sixty sessions, the share of their stocks above the 50-day average, and their median month; the four strongest stocks in each.
flow.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.
flow.bias: Sectors are NSE's list as it stands today, so a company since delisted has no sector here and could not be picked.

emerging.what: Companies listed six to twelve months, above their own 50-day average, whose leader score stands in the top half of the established universe; strongest first.
emerging.replay: The site's own engine run on every fifth session; its top fifteen bought at the next open.

before.what: The 150 highest technical scores on the exchange, momentum and accumulation setups, Rs 2 crore a day, ordered by the old trade score. Its targets cannot be replayed from prices, so it is shown WITHOUT them, which flatters it.

first_version.what: The lists as first built: this month was three parts leader score and one part five-day dip, and momentum did not give way to long term. Same dates, same rules.
